cases.sentence: Вот как Аарон должен приходить в святилище: с ___ для жертвы за грех и с бараном для всесожжения.
cases.explain: «молодым быком» — after the preposition «с», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: “Aaron shall come into the sanctuary with a young bull for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering.

cases.sentence: Пусть он надевает священный ___ и льняное нижнее белье.
cases.explain: «льняной халат» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: He shall put on the holy linen tunic. He shall have the linen trousers on his body, and shall put on the linen sash, and he shall be clothed with the linen turban. They are the holy garments. He shall bathe his body in water, and put them on.

cases.sentence: Пусть он опоясывается ___ и надевает льняной тюрбан.
cases.explain: «льняным поясом» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: He shall put on the holy linen tunic. He shall have the linen trousers on his body, and shall put on the linen sash, and he shall be clothed with the linen turban. They are the holy garments. He shall bathe his body in water, and put them on.

cases.sentence: Это ___: пусть он вымоется, прежде чем наденет их на себя.
cases.explain: «священные одеяния» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: He shall put on the holy linen tunic. He shall have the linen trousers on his body, and shall put on the linen sash, and he shall be clothed with the linen turban. They are the holy garments. He shall bathe his body in water, and put them on.

cases.sentence: Чтобы не умереть, Он положит благовоние на огонь перед Господом, и ___ покроет крышку искупления над ковчегом свидетельства.
cases.explain: «благовонный дым» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: He shall put the incense on the fire before Yahweh, that the cloud of the incense may cover the mercy seat that is on the covenant, so that he will not die.

cases.sentence: Он возьмет кровь ___ и с пальца окропит ею крышку спереди.
cases.explain: «молодого быка» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: He shall take some of the blood of the bull, and sprinkle it with his finger on the mercy seat on the east; and before the mercy seat he shall sprinkle some of the blood with his finger seven times.

cases.sentence: Пусть он заколет козла в жертву за грех народа, внесет его кровь за завесу и сделает с ней то же, что с кровью ___ — окропит ею крышку искупления и перед ней.
cases.explain: «молодого быка» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: “Then he shall kill the goat of the sin offering that is for the people, and bring his blood within the veil, and do with his blood as he did with the blood of the bull, and sprinkle it on the mercy seat and before the mercy seat.

cases.sentence: Пусть он возьмет кровь ___ и кровь козла и помажет ею все рога жертвенника.
cases.explain: «молодого быка» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: “He shall go out to the altar that is before Yahweh and make atonement for it, and shall take some of the bull’s blood, and some of the goat’s blood, and put it around on the horns of the altar.

cases.sentence: Пусть он вымоется в ___ и наденет обычную одежду.
cases.explain: «Святом месте» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: Then he shall bathe himself in water in a holy place, put on his garments, and come out and offer his burnt offering and the burnt offering of the people, and make atonement for himself and for the people.

cases.sentence: ___ и козла для жертвы за грех, чью кровь внесли в Святое Святых, чтобы совершить отпущение, нужно вынести из лагеря.
cases.explain: «Молодого быка» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: The bull for the sin offering, and the goat for the sin offering, whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the Holy Place, shall be carried outside the camp; and they shall burn their skins, their flesh, and their dung with fire.

cases.sentence: Это — суббота ___, и вы должны смирять себя.
cases.explain: «полного покоя» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: It is a Sabbath of solemn rest to you, and you shall afflict your souls. It is a statute forever.
